entry.title: The Valore Gallery
entry.desc: A room for every country in the library, plus the artist spotlights.
entry.howto.label: How to explore
entry.howto.desktop: Click and drag to look around. Click the floor to walk there, or use WASD / arrow keys (hold Shift to sprint). Click any piece on the wall to read about it.
entry.howto.mobile: Drag to look around. Tap the floor to walk there. Tap any piece on the wall to read about it.
hint.desktop: Drag to look · Click the floor to walk · Click a piece to read it
hint.mobile: Drag to look · Tap the floor to walk · Tap a piece to read it
home.heroTitle: Every country has more to it than the headlines show.
home.heroLede: Valore Library is a cultural library built from the places refugees, immigrants, and their families call home: the art, the food, the music, the history that runs deeper than a classroom unit ever covers. Not poverty. Not conflict. The whole picture.
home.discoverTitle: A living collection, not a brochure
home.discoverDesc: Real photography from every country featured here. Hover a piece to pause, click through to its full story.
home.cardExploreDesc: An interactive map. Click in and read about a region's everyday life, art, and history in both English and its own language.
home.cardVoicesDesc: Personal accounts from refugees and immigrants, in their own words. Submit yours or read others'.
home.cardPerspectivesDesc: Art, writing, and class projects from anyone exploring these cultures, open now.
home.quote: "Every human being arrives with value. I don't see refugees. I see doctors, artists, engineers and leaders waiting for the world to catch up."
footer.tagline: Valore Library: A Valore Group Initiative
